opsec_layers.objective: Redact tokens from source files before commit.
Block pipeline/commit if tokens are detected.
Panic application if genuine tokens exist in dev-configs.

core_engine.bin/deploy_engine.py: Hardened execution core; utilizes subprocess for reversed config loading.
core_engine.bin/github_sync.sh: w3m-based remote manifest synchronization for Linux CLI.

opsec_utilities.tools/extras/env_injector.py: Secure shell injection via tac-reversed configs.
opsec_utilities.tools/extras/dep_audit.py: Audits package manager output for leaks.

metrics_suite.src/derive_area_metrics.py: Hardened data processor; uses absolute path resolution for BASE.
metrics_suite.src/validate_metrics.py: Automated target comparison against state benchmarks.

operational_thresholds.tier_1_quick_fix: Run sanitize_tokens.py or validate_metrics.py. Risk: Low.
operational_thresholds.tier_2_moderate: Run github_sync.sh or update sys_env.rev. Risk: Low.
operational_thresholds.tier_3_nuclear: Run history_token_cleaner.py (Git history rewrite). Risk: High.

environment_spec.critical_path_logic: All paths must be resolved via Path(__file__).resolve() to prevent CWD crashes in Termux.
environment_spec.config_strategy: Secrets stored in .rev files and processed via tac to avoid plaintext persistence.
